what_happened: Job 20261025-001236-brde ("Point all records/ readers at a worktree of athena/records") failed in planning, before any code was written. After round 3 of 3 the critic still said the plan needed revising. It judged the plan mostly sound: the path is defined once in athena-data paths.rs, load_current forms sit beside the existing loaders, the live callers move, and a records-presence fallback is kept. One major finding remained. The study site generator reads studies/firstmate-work-handling, not records/, so rerooting it at the records worktree would break it, and the plan's criterion-1 demonstration for it cannot pass in a meaningful way. Two minor findings: the literal scan would flag citation strings in steward and work_decisions that are not readers, and the criterion-3 run command filters in a way that may not run the xtask scan test. The critic also listed about 17 minor findings that files are not among the reading's deliverables, but accepted them as justified by the request's Files line. The event lists no unmet acceptance criteria and no failed checks. Nothing was delivered.
cause: Nothing makes the reading or plan check its claims about what "all readers" are against the code before the critic runs. A request to reroot every reader of a data location was read as a sweep over everything that touches records, but one consumer (the site generator) reads a different directory. The critic is the first stage to open xtask/src/site.rs, and it has only three rounds and keeps no partial plan, so a late finding fails the job. The reading also lists too few deliverables for a sweep: the request's Files line names more files than the reading's list, so the critic adds many minor findings that are noise and crowd out the real one. The scan and its run command were designed without being run against the real tree. Nothing requires a sweeping change to enumerate its call sites, mark each in scope or out of scope with evidence, and show the scan test runs.
prevention: Add a required step to reading and planning for any request that changes "all" readers, writers or call sites. Before the plan is accepted, the stage must list every real call site found by searching the snapshot, mark each as in scope or out of scope with the file and line, and derive the deliverables list from that inventory. The deliverables list must include the files named on the request's Files line. Any consumer that reads a different path, such as the site generator, must be marked unaffected, with a demonstration that it still works. Any new scan must be run once against the real tree, and its run command must be shown to execute the test, before the critic sees the plan.
proposed_request:
Point every reader of records/ in Athena at a worktree of the athena/records branch, so that readers see the current records and not a stale checkout. Outcome: the records path is defined once in athena-data paths.rs, next to repo_state_dir. Records::load and RecordSet::load gain load_current forms that read from that worktree. The live callers move to them: status, auditor, reading, scope_guard, run, manage, proposals, audience, review, hestia, steward, code_health, work_decisions, backtest, drain, and xtask walltime. A fallback to the in-tree records/ directory applies only when the worktree is absent. Scope: the study site generator reads studies/firstmate-work-handling, not records/, so it must stay unchanged. Show that it still builds the same output, and do not reroot it. Files: the crates and tests named above, including crates/athena-cli/tests/records_branch_readers.rs. Acceptance:
- Each listed reader loads records through the single path in paths.rs, shown by a test that places different records in the worktree and in the in-tree directory and checks that the worktree's records are the ones returned.
- With no worktree present, each reader falls back to records/ and returns the same result as before.
- A scan test in xtask fails if any non-test code reads records/ directly outside paths.rs. It ignores citation strings in steward and work_decisions. Show it fails on a planted direct read, and run it with a command that is shown to execute that test.
- The site generator's output is byte-identical before and after the change.
- cargo fmt, clippy and the full test suite pass.
